Scenarios.SCN-001: only accepted unmodified native `read` results with canonical `value.path` become observations.
Scenarios.SCN-002: non-empty newly delivered context is injected via additionalContexts with a visible notice; empty/delivered context stays silent.
Scenarios.SCN-003: FLI_DIAGNOSTICS selects default/strict modes; unsupported values fall back with one configuration notice.
Scenarios.SCN-004: accepted unmodified bash results classify through the bundled classifier; non-read commands, blocked/replaced results, and classifier failures produce no observation and no guessing.
